# Accessibility Requirements Quality Checklist: Frame the Writing pages around Drift & Convergence

**Purpose**: Validate that the WCAG 2.2 AA requirements for the series marker, recoloured pills, new pages and redirects are complete, clear and measurable.
**Created**: 2026-10-01
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: Generated by `/speckit-checklist`. Items test the quality of the written requirements, not the implementation.

## Non-Colour Distinguishability

- [ ] CHK001 Is the rule that a series marker differs from a topic pill by more than colour stated as a requirement with named properties (text prefix, weight, outline)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-010]
- [ ] CHK002 Is "heavier weight" quantified (a named weight or token) rather than left relative? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-010]
- [ ] CHK003 Is "visible outline" quantified (width, and 3:1 non-text contrast against the page background in both themes)? [Measurability, Gap, Spec §FR-010]
- [ ] CHK004 Is the marker's accessible name specified, including whether "Series:" is read aloud as part of the link text? [Completeness, Spec §Clarifications 2026-10-01]
- [ ] CHK005 Are text-only card borders in the series colour required to carry no meaning that is lost without colour? [Gap, Spec §FR-010]

## Forced-Colours Mode

- [ ] CHK006 Are forced-colours requirements stated explicitly for the marker, the ordinary pills, the series banner and card borders? [Completeness, Spec §US3 AC4]
- [ ] CHK007 Is the expected forced-colours appearance defined (outline retained, text retained) so it can be objectively judged? [Measurability, Gap]
- [ ] CHK008 Is it specified whether the marker and a topic pill remain distinguishable in forced colours when both lose their fills? [Coverage, Spec §US3 AC4]

## Contrast

- [ ] CHK009 Is 4.5:1 required for every text and background pair in light and dark themes, including the new mauve, sand, lavender, sage and dusk pairs? [Completeness, Spec §FR-010a]
- [ ] CHK010 Are the pairs to be measured enumerated (pill, marker, banner, dusk pill, hover and focus states)? [Gap, Spec §FR-010a]
- [ ] CHK011 Is the non-text contrast requirement (1.4.11) for marker and pill outlines and focus indicators stated, not only text contrast? [Gap]
- [ ] CHK012 Does the spec say how contrast is measured and where the computed values are recorded, so the recolour is checkable? [Measurability, Spec §FR-010a]
- [ ] CHK013 Is hover and focus-visible styling for the marker defined and consistent with ordinary pills? [Consistency, Gap]

## Heading Structure and Landmarks

- [ ] CHK014 Is the heading level of the framing lead on `/writing/` specified relative to the page heading and the lead story? [Gap, Spec §FR-006]
- [ ] CHK015 Is the series banner heading level specified so each series page has one h1 and no skipped levels? [Gap, Spec §FR-009]
- [ ] CHK016 Is the heading structure for free-form topic pages stated as the same as controlled topic pages? [Consistency, Spec §FR-011]
- [ ] CHK017 Is the home page "Recent writing" intro line specified as a paragraph and not a new heading? [Clarity, Spec §FR-014]
- [ ] CHK018 Are landmark or labelled-region requirements defined for the framing lead and the series-to-series navigation? [Gap, Spec §FR-009]

## Link Purpose

- [ ] CHK019 Does each way into a series have link text that states its purpose out of context (not "Read more")? [Clarity, Spec §FR-006]
- [ ] CHK020 Is the link text for the other-series and back-to-Writing links on the banner specified? [Gap, Spec §FR-009]
- [ ] CHK021 Are the home "Recent writing" and About page series links required to have distinct, descriptive text? [Clarity, Spec §FR-014, §FR-015]
- [ ] CHK022 Is it specified that a post header's marker link names the series and not just "Series"? [Clarity, Spec §US3 AC2]
- [ ] CHK023 Are adjacent duplicate links (marker plus card title) addressed so keyboard and screen-reader users are not given redundant stops? [Gap]

## Redirect Behaviour

- [ ] CHK024 Is the redirect required to be a real HTTP redirect rather than a page with a timed meta refresh, so users are not trapped or delayed (WCAG 2.2.1, 3.2.5)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-008]
- [ ] CHK025 Is back-button behaviour after a redirect specified (no loop, history not trapped)? [Gap, Spec §FR-008]
- [ ] CHK026 Are redirects for paginated topic addresses defined so keyboard users on page N land on page N of the series? [Completeness, Spec §FR-008]
- [ ] CHK027 Is behaviour defined for the redirect with JavaScript off? [Coverage, Spec §FR-016]

## Responsive, Zoom and Motion

- [ ] CHK028 Is reflow at 320 CSS px and 200% zoom required for the marker, banner and lead, beyond "no horizontal scroll at phone width"? [Clarity, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK029 Are touch target size requirements (2.5.8, 24px) stated for markers, pills and series links? [Gap]
- [ ] CHK030 Is it stated that no motion or animation is added to the marker or banner? [Gap]

## Automated Check Coverage

- [ ] CHK031 Do the accessibility success criteria list every page template that changes (landing, both series pages, a free-form topic page, all posts, post, home, About)? [Coverage, Spec §SC-005]
- [ ] CHK032 Are manual checks required for what axe cannot test (forced colours, screen-reader wording, contrast of non-text)? [Gap, Spec §SC-005]
